files.title: Image URLs
files.description: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF or HEIF links (product photos, listings, portfolio shots).

text.title: Watermark text
text.description: e.g. © My Shop or @myshop. Ignored when a logo URL is given.

logoUrl.title: Logo URL
logoUrl.description: Use your logo instead of text. A PNG with a transparent background looks best.

color.title: Text colour
color.description: white, black or a hex colour like #ffcc00. Text gets a soft outline so it reads on any photo.

position.title: Position
position.description: A corner, an edge, the centre, or a repeated diagonal pattern over the whole image (hardest to crop out).

sizePercent.title: Size (% of image width)
sizePercent.description: Width of one watermark. Default 25 (22 for the tiled pattern).

marginPercent.title: Edge margin (%)
marginPercent.description: Space between the watermark and the edge, as % of the shorter side.

spacingPercent.title: Pattern spacing (%)
spacingPercent.description: Gap between tiles, as % of the watermark's size.

maxSide.title: Resize to (px, longest side)
maxSide.description: 0 keeps the original size. 2048 or 1200 suit marketplaces and social media.

format.title: Format
format.description: Auto keeps PNG and WebP as they are and saves everything else as JPG.

keepMetadata.title: Keep EXIF metadata
keepMetadata.description: Off (default) removes camera data and GPS location from the output.

zip.title: Bundle into one ZIP
zip.description: Also saves watermarked.zip with every image.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
